---
type: character
name: Tomas Vell
want: To keep the lamp lit until the relief keeper can do it alone
need: To let someone else carry part of the work
flaw: Says nothing when he should ask for help
voice: Terse. Short sentences, few words of address, almost no questions.
relationships:
  - character: relief-keeper
    note: Tomas thinks Ada talks too much, but he watches her hands and trusts her with the lamp.
---

Tomas Vell has kept the light on Gannet Skerry for nineteen winters. He does not explain the routine to new keepers. He shows them once and expects them to remember.
